Mississippi''' were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the four [[U.S. representative]]s from the [[U.S. state|State]] of [[Mississippi]], one each of the state's four [[Mississippi's congressional districts|congressional districts]]. The elections coincided with the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], as well as [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2024 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]].
